title: Director, Insights
description:
Who we are:
Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste-the biggest growth killer of all-and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti , reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We support 100% remote work for this role!

We’d love to hear from you if:
Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.
As a Director, Insights , you will lead the analytics strategy for a portfolio of client business by turning complex media, performance, and business data into clear measurement frameworks, learning agendas, and high-value recommendations. You’ll serve as the senior analytics partner to client and internal leaders, helping them understand what is happening across channels, why it matters, and what should happen next. This role is highly client-facing and best suited for someone who combines strong measurement judgment, consultative presence, and business acumen with enough technical fluency to guide sophisticated analytical work without personally operating as a data scientist or data engineer every day.

Key responsibilities

Client‑Centric

• Lead the development of holistic, enterprise-level measurement frameworks that move beyond channel-specific metrics to capture broader business impact.

• Design and oversee multi-year learning agendas and sophisticated testing roadmaps that align with long-term client objectives and strategic business questions.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor on measurement strategy, analytical implications, and industry shifts.

• Identify opportunities where advanced analytics can solve business problems, help scope the right analytical approach, and support the growth of high-value analytics work.

• Act as the senior guardian of the analytical relationship, proactively identifying potential friction points and ensuring insights remain indispensable to client success.

Product‑Led

• Use and shape reporting, BI, dashboarding, and insight-delivery environments so they better support strategic decision-making and client storytelling.

• Partner with BI and Data Engineering leads to ensure the data environment supports the strategic vision without requiring you to personally own underlying pipelines or code infrastructure.

• Help improve how analytics outputs are surfaced to clients and internal teams, including dashboards, visualizations, and strategic readouts.

• Stay current on new technologies, data platforms, and measurement developments, and recommend improvements that strengthen the quality, speed, and usefulness of analytics delivery.

• Bring strong technical fluency to cross-functional discussions so analytics, BI, and engineering teams can work toward the same business and client priorities.

Data & Measurement‑Driven

• Lead the design of measurement frameworks that connect media performance to business outcomes, long-term brand health, and enterprise-level ROI.

• Guide the use of advanced methods such as incrementality testing, forecasting, campaign evaluation, and broader modern measurement approaches where appropriate.

• Help clients navigate the transition to more modern measurement approaches, including privacy-safe strategies and more integrated views of marketing effectiveness.

title: Data Scientist II, Applied ML
description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Data at Brex

The Data organization develops infrastructure, statistical models, and products using financial data. Our Scientists and Engineers work together to make data -and insights derived from data - a core asset across the company. Our work is ingrained in Brex’s decision-making process, in the efficiency of our operations, in our risk management policies, and in the second-to-none experience we provide our consumers.

What You’ll Do

Our Data Scientists are responsible for the entire model development lifecycle, from conception with stakeholders, through model development and productionization, to following through to see that the desired business impact is achieved - including circling back with stakeholders to make product or strategic decisions.

Responsibilities

• Drive Data & AI solutions from inception to deployment to efficiently manage risk and/or improve customer experience.

• Be responsible for the full machine learning lifecycle - problem identification, model design, training, productionization, and monitoring.

• Partner with cross-functional teams (Ops, Engineering, Product, Fraud, Compliance, and Credit).

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in Data Science/ML roles, or 2+ years with a PhD in a quantitative field

• Demonstrated ability to own end-to-end model development, including productionization

• Expertise in Python programming, SQL queries, and ML-related frameworks

• Ability to apply statistical techniques such as hypothesis testing and A/B testing, and to approach problems with a statistical mindset

• Strong software engineering fundamentals, including experience with API development and integrating ML systems into production services

• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with various stakeholders, both technical and non-technical

Nice to Have

• Experience working with real-time models

• Advanced degree (MSc/PhD) or published research in Machine Learning or a related field

• Previous experience in the risk domain (fraud, AML, and/or credit) or building customer-facing ML models (suggestions/automations)

• Experience in the fintech industry

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $152,000 - $190,000 + equity. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. 

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

title: Materials Manager, Networking & Hardware
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE SUPPLY CHAIN TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Supply tens of gigawatts of compute, the largest build out of compute in history. Qualify and dual-source across every critical equipment category, with lead-time and capacity thresholds tied directly to the forward build pipeline.

- Make supply chain the reason we build faster than anyone. Our modular build redefines speed in this industry, and it lives or dies on supply chain. Keep procurement permanently off the critical path so schedule compression stays our advantage, not our constraint.

- Build the most accurate supply chain prediction modelling that exists. Use the frontier of AI to forecast lead times, demand, and disruption with a precision the industry has never had, and turn that foresight into a structural edge.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own the networking hardware category: switches, routers, and DPUs for fabrics connecting 100k+ accelerator clusters.

- Negotiate supply agreements with networking OEMs covering price, lead time, and roadmap access.

- Dual-source critical switch platforms and manage the qualification burden that dual-sourcing creates.

- Align buy plans with network engineering roadmaps so hardware generations land when designs need them, not after.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

- You've sourced networking hardware at scale from major OEMs.

- You've handled end-of-life and generation transitions without stranding inventory or stalling builds.

- You understand enough of the technology (optics, ASICs, port speeds) to negotiate credibly with product teams.

- You keep firmware, licensing, and support terms from becoming the expensive surprise later.

- Bonus: AI/HPC fabric hardware. White-box and ODM switching. Optics supply chains. Vendor financing structures.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

title: Data Infrastructure Engineer
description:
TL;DR: Build the data infrastructure the Lovable agent runs on: ingestion, storage and query for millions of small tenants instead of one large one. You'll join the Data Platform team, and your work decides whether the apps people build on Lovable can rely on their data.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

- An infrastructure engineer who has built and run data systems in production at scale, and wants the harder version of the problem: millions of tiny tenants on shared infrastructure.

- Deep experience in at least one layer (ingestion, storage formats and table layout, query execution, or orchestration), and the range to work across the others.

- Experience with multi-tenant or untrusted workloads: isolation, noisy neighbours, and keeping cost per tenant low.

- Good judgment on calls no one can check for you: the right abstraction, the tradeoff between cost and latency, whether a design holds at 10x.

- You work with AI agents end to end. Your output is the systems you build, not the code you type by hand.

- You ship, and you own what you ship in production.

What you’ll do

- Build ingestion that accepts events from millions of Lovable apps, treats every producer as untrusted, and keeps one tenant's bad traffic from slowing or corrupting another's data.

- Build managed analytical storage for every user, including schema management, partitioning, and compaction of a constant stream of small writes.

- Make queries fast when you can't keep compute warm for every tenant.

- Build the runtime for agent-written connectors: isolated execution, credentials, scheduling, retries and state.

- Make cost per tenant measurable, then drive it down, through metering, limits and workload isolation.

- Expose data, metadata and tools to the Lovable agent so it can build software on customers' data.

- Run what you build, including observability, freshness and recovery.

The tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

- Languages: Go, Rust, Python, SQL

- Data: ClickHouse, BigQuery, Parquet on object storage

- Streaming & orchestration: Pub/Sub, Temporal

- Cloud: GCP, Cloudflare, AWS

- DevOps & tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, Terraform

And always on the lookout for what's next.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Safety Engineering
tags: Quality Reliability & System Safety : Quality Engineering
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM
Anduril’s Manufacturing Safety Engineering team partners across Anduril’s manufacturing, engineering, and operations organizations to ensure our production systems are safe to build, test, and sustain at scale. As an engineering discipline, we design safety into the way products are made, covering the equipment, fixtures, test stations, and work instructions on the factory floor, rather than inspecting for it after the fact. Our mandate spans the production lifecycle, from new equipment and line design through ramp and sustained operations. We apply formal risk assessment and the hierarchy of controls to identify hazards early and engineer them out, partnering closely with our Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) experts, controls and manufacturing engineers, and production leadership to keep our people safe while moving at the speed Anduril demands.

ABOUT THE JOB
We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Safety Engineering leader to join our rapidly growing team in Costa Mesa, CA to stand up and scale manufacturing safety as an engineering discipline across Anduril. This is a build role: you will create the manufacturing-safety-engineering team, define the risk-assessment framework and processes that keep our production equipment, fixtures, test stations, and work instructions safe, and drive adoption of those practices across Anduril’s manufacturing sites. As a Manufacturing Safety leader, you will apply deep expertise in machine safety, formal risk assessment, and the hierarchy of controls to engineer hazards out of how our products are built, partnering closely with EHS, manufacturing and controls engineering, and production leadership. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who can set strategy and standards while remaining the senior authority on the hardest hazard problems on the floor.
This role is based in Costa Mesa, CA, and supports Anduril’s manufacturing operations, including sites at Quonset Point, RI and Atlanta, GA; travel to production sites is expected.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Build, lead, and develop the Manufacturing Safety Engineering team, including hiring, leveling, mentoring, and performance management, as the discipline scales across Anduril.

• Establish and standardize the manufacturing-safety framework: risk-assessment methodology, templates, risk-acceptance criteria, safety sign-off gates, and the management-of-change process, aligned to the business.

• Grow the manufacturing-safety discipline across Anduril, driving adoption across production lines and sites and defining the standards of record, in partnership with Manufacturing, EHS, and product engineering.

• Define and communicate the discipline’s vision, goals, roadmap, and operating model, and integrate manufacturing-safety practices across all stages of production development.

• Own manufacturing-safety metrics, KPIs, and executive-level reporting; represent the discipline to leadership and to customer and defense-program stakeholders.

• Manage resource allocation and capacity planning across concurrent programs and sites, and manage budget, tooling, and external partnerships (EHS, controls integrators, certification bodies).

• Serve as the senior technical authority and final risk-acceptance esca

description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We're at an inflection point. We started with core durable execution and are now evolving with the world as it transitions to AI. What it takes to get from where we are today to a world where Temporal underpins all software - including and especially agents - is going to be different. It will require unprecedented speed, iteration, market and customer focus, and invention.

As an Agent Connectivity PM, you’ll help the world makes its transition to AI on Temporal. Without any effort, the market has already identified Temporal as a good substrate for agent workloads. But what makes agents powerful is connecting them to services and data. We are in the infancy of building out our connectivity layer, called Nexus, which has been the brainchild of our founder, Maxim, for many years. We now need to realize the full vision of Nexus by continuing to build out foundational capabilities like xyz and importantly, building agent-specific features and integrations, e.g., MCP connector, tool registry. You’ll identify the highest leverage areas for us to invest, and work closely with the founder/CTO and engineering team to get them to market.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Deeply understand problems faced by agent builders and identify opportunities where our products can make building agents faster, more intuitive, more reliable, and more powerful.

- Define and build what’s next for Temporal. Own strategy and roadmap for agent connectivity. Turn ambiguous signals into clear product theses. How should we prioritize new capabilities like identity propagation or rate limits? How do we bootstrap an ecosystem of connectors?

- Perform up-front discovery and translate customer, field, and open-source community signals into small tweaks, brand new abstractions, or platform bets.

- Help engineers and designers deeply understand user needs, empowering them to make great product decisions.

- Craft messaging around upcoming features that resonates with users.

- Enable sales and marketing teams to effectively communicate with and win customers.

- Strong technical depth. Ability to reason about distributed systems, workflow orchestration, service-to-service communication, APIs, SDKs, identity, and authorization.

- Developer-platform experience. Experience with infrastructure, platforms, integrations, APIs, SDKs, service mesh, API gateways, or cloud developer products.

You’ll build new things with a massive tailwind behind you: a proven technology, a large and growing customer base, and a market moving toward problems Temporal is uniquely equipped to solve. The opportunity is to turn that momentum into what comes next-not simply scale what already works. You’ll be expected to move fast, work across boundaries, and do what it takes to make it happen.

WHO YOU ARE

- You're ambitious. You want to win big. You don’t need someone else to set the pace. You get impatient when good ideas stay in slide decks, Slack, or meetings.

- You're an owner. You are accountable to results over the process. You’re less focused on your swim lane and more focused on making the company successful. You have exceptional product and operational judgement.

- You're resilient. Building at a high-growth company in 2026 is not for the faint of heart. You see the challenges and change as not just normal, but actually desirable.

- You want to grow, and help others grow. You self-reflect often. You give feedback, and you seek it out. You have shameless curiosity and a propensity to question things deeply.

- You prioritize the customer above all else. You want to understand our users' world and prioritize solving their problems above everything else.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- You have 8+ years of product management experience

- You have technical depth, with experience working on platform, infrastructure, developer tools, or other technical products

- You have worked at a startup, high-growth company or in a similarly intense and ambiguous environment

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

title: Director, Media Planning - REMOTE
description:
Be part of an amazing story.
Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.
Job Overview
The Director, Media Planning leads media strategy development, audience planning, and yield optimization for Macy’s Media Network. This leader brings deep expertise in media planning and yield management and effectively manages a team of media planners and inventory analysts. They demonstrate relentless curiosity and translate complex details into targeted media solutions and revenue-maximizing strategies. They also excel at leading people and projects in a fast-paced environment while driving strong business results.
What You Will Do

• Lead and develop a team of media planners responsible for creating integrated media plans that support strategic sales proposals. Provide guidance on placement recommendations that align with advertiser KPIs, campaign objectives, and proven performance insights. Ensure plans span all onsite and offsite media offerings while optimizing both campaign outcomes and profit margins.

• Establish and maintain effective planning and proposal processes across Media Planning and Sales to ensure all deadlines, deliverables, and client commitments are met.

• Advance audience segmentation and audience enrichment strategies to strengthen targeting capabilities and improve campaign effectiveness.

• Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving media capabilities to ensure Macy’s Media Network remains a leader in audience targeting and media strategy.

• Define and drive the strategy for curated private marketplaces (PMPs) to maximize advertiser value and revenue opportunities.

• Conduct inventory analysis and forecasting across advertising platforms to support planning, pricing, and revenue optimization.

• Lead yield management initiatives to maximize advertising revenue and inventory performance across channels.

• Apply quantitative analysis to identify value-maximizing inventory allocation and monetization strategies.

• Partner cross-functionally to identify pricing and revenue opportunities and provide recommendations to the Head of Advertising Operations on rate card optimization and pricing strategy.

• Collaborate closely with Ad Operations to ensure media plans are operationally sound, effectively integrated, and flawlessly executed.

• Serve as a strategic advisor to the Sales organization by providing training, guidance, and best practices related to audience targeting, media strategy, fill-rate optimization, and CPM growth opportunities.

• Recruit, onboard, develop, and coach media planning and yield optimization talent, building a scalable, high-performing team that supports business growth.

• Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.

• In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need
Media Planning Strategy: Deep expertise in developing integrated media strategies across onsite and offsite channels that align advertiser objectives, audience insights, and performance KPIs to deliver strong campaign results.
Yield Management: Proven ability to optimize advertising inventory, fill rates, CPMs, and overall revenue through data-driven yield management strategies and inventory allocation decisions.
Analytical Skills: Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret complex data, generate actionable insights, and make informed business recommendations.

title: Consultant - Child Rights
description:
ChildFund Australia is a member of the ChildFund Alliance - a global network of 10 organisations which assists almost 36 million children and their families in 66 countries. ChildFund Australia directly manages and implements programs with a range of local partners in Cambodia, Myanmar, Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste, Vietnam, and other Pacific nations, and manages projects delivered by partner organisations throughout Asia, Africa, and the Americas.
Purpose
ChildFund seeks to strengthen its existing participation approach so that stakeholders can engage with, validate, challenge, and enrich the findings of Child Rights Situation Analyses, helping to identify priority issues, emerging trends, evidence gaps, and opportunities for action. The resulting insights will inform organisational strategy, country planning, program portfolios, advocacy priorities, and investment decisions, ensuring that these are grounded not only in published evidence but also in the perspectives and experiences of children and communities themselves.
This assignment will develop practical guidelines, tools, and supporting resources that enable this process to be undertaken consistently across country contexts. The approach should be low burden, repeatable, and designed to leverage existing community engagement structures wherever possible, recognising the capacity constraints facing Country Offices and partners. It should also promote accountability by establishing clear mechanisms for reporting back on how participant feedback influenced findings, priorities, and subsequent decisions.
The consultant will also provide technical advice on the role of Youth Voice in ChildFund’s strategy development and broader strategic decision-making, including its evolving purpose, Terms of Reference, engagement processes and feedback mechanisms.
The consultancy period is 20 days spread across 3 months.
Interested consultants should submit an expression of interest including: a technical proposal (max. 3 pages) outlining understanding of the assignment, proposed search strategy and sources, and workplan; a financial proposal/fee schedule in USD; a curriculum vitae including at least two references from similar assignments; and a sample of previous, similar written work.
ChildFund Australia believes in a global community where children are safe and can reach their full potential. We take extensive steps to safeguard children in any work done by our people, i.e., our staff, volunteers and interns, supporters, partners, board members, ambassadors and suppliers. We strive to keep children safe through child safe practices, and rigorously ensure we prevent, oppose, and combat all exploitation and abuse of children and vulnerable people. As part of this commitment, all people working with us will undergo relevant background checks before joining ChildFund Australia .
At ChildFund Australia , all staff must remain alert and responsive to any child safeguarding or sexual exploitation, abuse, or harassment (SEAH) risks. Staff will acquire the knowledge and skills needed to understand our Child Safeguarding and PSEAH policies & procedures, promote strong safeguarding practices, and conduct themselves consistent with these policies.
In line with our values, diversity of people and ideas is critical to our work and our success at ChildFund Australia . We strive for a team culture that is welcoming, inclusive, and supportive. ChildFund is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and strongly encourages people from all backgrounds, abilities, and identities to apply

title: Senior Database Administrator (Freelancer)
description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores ' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60-70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migrations don't fail at conversion. They fail at go-live DMS latency nobody diagnosed, autovacuum behavior nobody tuned, privilege mappings nobody tested, incidents nobody owns at 2 a.m. This role sits inside our Application & Database Modernization pillar and exists to make sure that doesn't happen.
As our Senior Database Administrator, you'll run the Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL environments in an active Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration program from cluster design through DMS replication through post-go-live stabilization. Aedeon handles the repeatable conversion and validation work; you own what agents can't: production judgment. When replication lags, when a workload misbehaves after cutover, when an incident escalates past L2, you're the person who resolves it and can explain why it happened.
This is a freelance engagement, remote, working as the L3 escalation point on production systems that real businesses run on.
What you will do?

• Design, set up, configure, and manage Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL clusters.

• Configure parameters, maintenance windows, monitoring, and scaling strategies.

• Keep the environments highly available, fault tolerant, and operationally ready - before go-live, not after.

• Map users, roles, and privileges from Oracle to PostgreSQL.

• Implement least-privilege access, role hierarchies, and security best practices, and support audit and compliance requirements.

• Configure, run, monitor, and optimize AWS DMS tasks (Full Load and CDC).

EggAI is a fast-growing AI consulting and development startup. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets.

The role

You will lead our clients through the organisational and operational changes needed to establish a shared AI platform. The platform has two parts: an AI Control Plane that governs what agents may do and records the evidence, and a managed AI Runtime where the agents run. Both integrate with the client's identity, security, delivery and audit services, and both need owners, approval routes and support arrangements on the client side.

You will own delivery outcomes from mobilisation through production release and operating handover, acting as the client sponsor's day-to-day counterpart. The role reaches across engineering, business leadership, security, risk, compliance and operations. Why this role

Most organisations are still working out how to let AI agents act safely in production: who approves what an agent may do, how its actions are evidenced, and who answers when something goes wrong. The operating models, approval routes and assurance practices you design with our clients will shape how they run agentic AI for years, and they will become the basis of how EggAI delivers across Europe.

About WovenX Health : We are an expanding telehealth company committed to delivering accessible, high-quality specialty care remotely. Our innovative AI-powered platform connects patients with specialty-trained Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) within minutes, addressing the increasing demand for specialty care.
Initially focused on gastroenterology-the highest-demand specialty-WovenX is now expanding to additional specialties to streamline care delivery. By reducing unnecessary ER visits and maximizing resource efficiency, WovenX delivers faster, more accessible, and cost-effective specialty care.
About the role

• Work remotely on your schedule as a GI Advanced Practice Provider. We are actively looking for NPs and PAs with GI clinical experience with weekend and evening availability.

• This team of advanced practice providers will see patients virtually on behalf of brick and mortar GI centers. They are supported by our AI-enabled platform and our board-certified gastroenterologists in partnership with practice staff to assess patients, develop treatment plans, and order follow up as required.

• We want to take great care of patients and also give agency back to providers. Practice with autonomy, create your own schedule, and work from home.

What you'll do

• Provide GI-specific telehealth visits in partnership with brick-and-mortar GI centers

• Perform patient assessments and develop evidence-based treatment plans

• Prescribe medications when appropriate

• Order and interpret diagnostic testing; communicate results and next steps

• Coordinate care and refer to specialists or primary providers when indicated

Qualifications

• Nurse practitioner or Physician Assistant

• Minimum of 1 year outpatient GI experience

• Digital competency with EHRs and AI-supported workflows

• Demonstrated problem-solving and continuous improvement mindset

• Highly collaborative; effective communicator

• Patient-centered approach to care

• Able to work independently with sound clinical judgment

• Multiple state licenses preferred

title: Responsabile vendite

title: Principal Software Development Engineer
description:

Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Exposure Management & Security Operations department. In this role, you will architect, build, and scale critical security operations and exposure management infrastructure. You will drive end-to-end technical execution, mentor engineering talent, and lead the delivery of high-performance microservices and cloud-native solutions.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• 13+ years of hands-on software application development experience with distributed systems and cloud storage solutions

• Proficiency with Java, Spring frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security), and containerization with Docker or Kubernetes

title: Senior Accountant – Accounts Payable (m/w/d)
description:
Bei Statista dreht sich alles um Daten und Fakten, denn wir sind die weltweit führende Business Data Plattform. Durch die Bereitstellung verlässlicher und einfach nutzbarer Daten sowie verschiedener Datenanalyseprodukte und -dienstleistungen unterstützen wir Menschen weltweit, faktenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

2007 in Hamburg gegründet, haben wir uns schnell zu einem globalen Unternehmen mit Büros in Metropolen wie London, New York und Tokio entwickelt. Und wir haben auch weiterhin viel vor. Unser stetiges Wachstum ist nicht nur Beweis für unseren Erfolg, sondern schafft auch immer neue Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen.

Wir schätzen und feiern unsere vielfältige Kultur. Hier bist Du willkommen, egal, wer Du bist, woher Du kommst, wie Du aussiehst oder welche Graphen und Diagramme Du bevorzugst. Deine Geschichte ist wichtig - schreibe sie weiterhin als Teil unseres Teams. Überzeuge dich selbst und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Dein Job

'• Kreditorenbuchhaltung im Tagesgeschäft: Du bearbeitest Eingangsrechnungen und klärst Abweichungen und offene Posten eigenständig. Auch bei hohem Volumen sorgst du für zügige Bearbeitung und verlässlich hohe Qualität.

• Verantwortung für den Prozess: Du behältst den gesamten Purchase-to-Pay-Prozess (P2P) im Blick - von Bestellung über Wareneingang und Rechnungsprüfung bis zur Zahlung - und arbeitest eng mit den beteiligten Teams zusammen.

• Abschlüsse und Abstimmungen: Du stimmst Kreditorenkonten ab, bearbeitest Klärfälle und lieferst belastbare Beiträge zu den Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen.

• Prozessverbesserung und Projekte: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe über Teamgrenzen hinweg, identifizierst Engpässe und setzt Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen um.

• Automatisierung und KI: Du prüfst, wo Automatisierung und KI die Bearbeitung sinnvoll unterstützen können, und gestaltest Lösungen mit, die Effizienz und Qualität verbessern - mit angemessenen Kontrollen und fachlicher Prüfung.

Dein Profil

'• Fundierte Praxis in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung: Du beherrschst das operative Geschäft sicher, priorisierst auch bei hohem Belegaufkommen gut und lieferst eigenständig präzise Ergebnisse.

• End-to-End-Verständnis: Du kennst die wesentlichen Teilbereiche des P2P-Prozesses aus der Praxis und hast bereits Projekte zur Analyse oder Verbesserung bereichsübergreifender Abläufe begleitet.

• SAP-Erfahrung: Du hast in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung mit SAP gearbeitet; Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA ist besonders willkommen.

• Gestaltungswille: Du hinterfragst Routinen konstruktiv, denkst über die eigene Aufgabe hinaus und setzt Verbesserungen pragmatisch um.

• Offenheit für neue Technologien: Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Automatisierung und KI Kreditorenprozesse verbessern können. Spezifische KI-Toolkenntnisse setzen wir nicht voraus.

• Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Was wir bieten

Neben unserem großartigen Team, unserer Unternehmenskultur und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, Menschen mit Daten zu empowern, gibt es viele weitere Gründe, warum Statista ein großartiger Arbeitsplatz ist! Werde Teil unseres Teams und profitiere von folgenden Vorteilen:

- Arbeiten aus dem Ausland: 10 Tage pro Jahr (bis zu 30 Tage, wenn deine Familie im Ausland lebt)

- Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten

- Internationales Team und regelmäßige Teamevents

- Karriere- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

- Attraktive Standorte und moderne Büros

- Unterstützung für mentale Gesundheit durch OpenUp

Einige der hier aufgeführten Benefits gelten nur für die deutsche Gesellschaft und für Positionen ab Junior-Level.

title: Cybersecurity Cloud Subject Matter Expert
description:
Overview

Please note that this position is contingent upon the successful award of a contract currently under bid.
Global in service but local in approach, Nisga'a Tek is committed to high-quality service to those who defend us. Nisga'a Tek ensures mission assurance and execution for customers and warfighters. Providing intelligence, IT, cyber security, training, logistics, administrative, acquisition, and background investigation services.
Summary:
The Cybersecurity Cloud Subject Matter Expert will ensure the architecture and design of cloud-hosted IT systems are secure and meet DOD requirements.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

• Reviews Cloud security policy and provides recommendations for improvement to enhance the security posture within the cloud as well as the ability to meet protection, detection, monitoring and response requirements for systems and data.

• Applies knowledge of current advances in cloud security engineering and cloud security threats to provide support for the deployment of programs and applications.

• Provides input to programs throughout the process of deployment to ensure systems meet DOD compliance requirements.

• Provides guidance to assessment staff in the performance of Cybersecurity Vulnerability Assessments as related to cloud hosting environments.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

• Excellent organizational skills.

• Familiar with information security and assurance principles and associated supporting technologies.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Minimum of Seven (7) years of experience securing and architecting complex IT systems.

• At least Five (5) years in cloud environments (e.g., OCI, AWS, Azure).

• Experience leading or significantly contributing to cloud security assessments, audits, or compliance reviews.

• Extensive knowledge of cloud security best practices, frameworks, and standards (e.g., CIS Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CSA Cloud Controls Matrix).

• Cloud certification (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure, etc.)

• Experience working with enterprise DoD IT.

• Required to possess a DOD SECRET Clearance and be eligible for an IT-I Critical Sensitive security clearance or Tier 5 (T5) at time of proposal submission.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field
Pay and Benefits
The annual salary range for this position is $115,000 - $185,000.
At Goldbelt , we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

title: Project Manager, Core
description:

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

title: Growth Strategist
description:
GROWTH STRATEGIST

At Fresh Prints , we work with thousands of customers, but not every customer should have the same experience with us.

Some might be ordering for the first time. Others have been buying from us for years. Some need an occasional reminder or a well-timed offer, while others represent significant opportunities that deserve a much more personalized approach.

Today, we reach these customers through emails, SMS, automated journeys, promotional campaigns, gifting programs, and direct outreach. We've built much of the infrastructure to make these things possible, but there's a much bigger opportunity ahead of us: bringing all of these touchpoints together into a thoughtful, cohesive strategy for how we grow our customer relationships.

That's what we're hiring a Growth Strategist to do.

Your job is to understand our customers, figure out what they need at different stages of their relationship with Fresh Prints , and build experiences that make them want to engage, purchase, return, and grow with us.

For some customers, that might mean a great email at exactly the right moment. For others, it might mean an entirely different experience, with personalized outreach, exclusive offers, samples, or programs designed around their long-term potential.

We don't want someone who thinks about growth as a collection of campaigns or channels. We want someone who can see the bigger picture, identify where the opportunities are, and turn those opportunities into programs that drive meaningful business results.

This isn't a role where you inherit a finished playbook. You'll have the freedom, and responsibility, to question how we do things today, build better systems, and shape what customer growth looks like at Fresh Prints .

This role is about:

•
Understanding our customers deeply: Who they are, what they care about, why they buy, what brings them back, and what makes them disengage.

•
Designing the right experience for different customers: Knowing when automation and great content are enough, and when a relationship deserves a more personalized, high-touch approach.

•
Finding opportunities to grow customer value: Identifying where we're losing customers, leaving revenue on the table, or missing opportunities to build stronger relationships.

•
Being a great marketer: Understanding what makes someone open an email, click a link, respond to an offer, or take the next step, and being able to create that experience yourself.

•
Turning ideas into execution: Building programs, writing compelling content, coordinating teams, testing approaches, and taking ownership of the results.

•
Building systems that scale: Using data, technology, AI, and automation to create experiences that become smarter and more effective over time.

What You'll Own

Understanding Customers & Finding Growth Opportunities
